description.content: List every dictionary belonging to the caller's project.
Create a new dictionary scoped to the caller's project.
Fetch a single dictionary by ID.
Delete a dictionary (cascades to its entries).
List entries in a dictionary with optional search and pagination.
Add a single entry to a dictionary.

Replace all entries in the dictionary with the supplied list.

Atomic semantics: upsert every supplied entry by
``(dictionary_id, word)``, then delete any existing entries whose
word is not in the payload. The cache is invalidated once at the
end.
Update an entry's word / replacement / ipa / case_sensitive.

Invalidate cached dictionary entries for a project.

Internal endpoint — requires master-key authentication. Called by
the web app after dictionary mutations so the TTS backend picks up
changes immediately instead of waiting for the cache TTL to expire.
Unified API: REST + WebSocket + ElevenLabs + Vapi
